status: Read-only sensitivity analysis; no import policy or production evidence rule is adopted.

unit_recovery.scaled_syntax: Only an explicit 10^integer prefix followed by a supported concentration unit. Apostrophe exponent notation remains manual review.
unit_recovery.mass_identity_requirement: Measured ChEMBL record is a structured Small molecule with a positive full_mwt and a canonical structure. Use that measured record, never the parent freebase weight.
unit_recovery.mass_caveat: Conditional sensitivity only: source-record identity does not prove whether the publication expressed mass as salt, freebase, hydrate or formulation. Verify original material before adopting.
unit_recovery.upstream_flags: Preserved; sensitivity follows baseline treatment rather than silently excluding flags. Conversion fixes dimensions, not assay interpretation.

evidence_bases.human_single: Human SINGLE PROTEIN; experiment confidence 9, relationship D, no variant. Supported curated claims retained at this target level.
evidence_bases.human_single_and_complex: human_single plus human PROTEIN COMPLEX; experiment confidence 7, relationship D, no variant. Each complex remains one target.
evidence_bases.human_with_families: human_single_and_complex plus human PROTEIN COMPLEX GROUP (confidence 7) and PROTEIN FAMILY (confidence 5); D, no variant for experiments. Each group/family remains one target.

experimental_tier_rule: Supported requires >=2 distinct publication-class study keys within one role:endpoint. Preliminary requires >=1 identifiable study. No curated claim upgrades an experimental role.

policies.label: CNS indication Approved or Phase 3 only
Whole ATC N plus CNS indication Approved
Whole ATC N plus CNS indication Approved or Phase 3
Whole ATC N plus CNS indication Approved or Phase 2/3

scope_note: Every policy uses S0 core indications; scope extensions are counted separately but their added molecules have not undergone the baseline evidence assessment.
organism_note: Retain all excluded rows in a separate context inventory. Protein-assigned rows are manually classified by assay description; no whole-organism observation is pooled with in-vitro binding/functional potency.
